title: Move to String Catalogs
description:
Localization lives in legacy .strings and .stringsdict files: verbose, easy to leave untranslated, plurals in a separate file, and no signal when a translation drifts from the source. String Catalogs — .xcstrings — fix that:

  • Simpler files — one catalog per module instead of scattered .strings and .stringsdict.
  • Simpler plurals — declare plural variants inline, no separate .stringsdict.
  • Stale-translation flags — Xcode marks translations that fell behind the source string.
